thread:
Sahil: Heads-up — Ember private VPC cutover is scheduled for Thu 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC. This is the quiet cutover window for the customer. Need: deploy owner, smoke-runner, DB owner, netops, and rollback plan. Who can own the slot?
Maria: I can take deploy owner. I’ll be the single point for push/monitoring.
Alex: I’ll run smoke tests and validate latency/throughput. Will prepare a short script.
Jenna: I’ll own DB migration/rollforward/rollback steps. No schema changes, just index refresh + vacuum.
netops: We’re on firewall rule changes — will need a 5-min prep and 5-min verify window. I’ll be available during the window.
deploy-bot: Reminder: preflight checks complete for ember v1.3.2 image. All infra green. (link to runbook)
Sahil: Thanks. Quick clarifications: 1) Expected duration? 2) Canary %? 3) Immediate rollback trigger thresholds?
Maria: Plan: 40m total. 02:00 — start deploy (10m), 02:10 — canary traffic 10% (15m), 02:25 — promote to full if no regressions (15m).
Alex: Smoke checklist (run after canary):
- `curl -f -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://ember-api.internal/healthz` (expect 200)
- `curl -sS https://ember-api.internal/v1/embeddings?size=32` (sample response length > 500 chars)
- run synthetics: `python smoke/ember_smoke.py --iterations 10` (latency p95 < 300ms)
I’ll post results in this thread.
Jenna: DB steps (short):
- Lockless index refresh: `pg_repack --table events` (run prior, completes in < 10m)
- Post-deploy verify: `SELECT count(1) FROM events WHERE processed_at IS NULL LIMIT 1;`
Rollback note: restore read replicas first, then fail traffic back to old pool.
netops: Firewall change: add rule to allow 10.8.0.0/16 -> 172.16.10.0/24 on ports 443/22. Template: `iptables` rules will be staged, rollback = remove rule and flush conntrack.
Sahil: Rollback criteria: >2% error spike on embeddings endpoint sustained 3m OR p95 latency > 500ms sustained 5m. Agreed?
Maria: Agreed. Also manual abort if customer reports functional regressions.
Alex: I’ll run an automated smoke and post a short table. If any smoke fails, we stop and rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started at 2905006920 by Maria. Canary traffic: 10% -> ember-canary-01
Alex: Canary smoke results: healthz OK, embeddings sample passed, p95 = 260ms. No errors in logs. Posting brief logs: `grep ERROR /var/log/ember/*.log | tail -n 5` -> none.
Jenna: DB post-checks look good: no backlog increase, replica lag < 500ms.
netops: Firewall rule applied and verified (conntrack cleared).
Sahil: Great. Proceeding to promote at 02:25 UTC. Maria, proceed when ready.
Maria: Promoting now. Rolling out to remaining nodes with rolling restart parallelism=3.
deploy-bot: Rollout 50% complete.
Alex: Full smoke run in progress (samples 50). p95 holding ~275ms. No functional failures so far.
Maria: Rollout complete. Final monitoring window 02:40-03:00 UTC. Please escalate into #incidents if anything odd.
Sahil: Final checklist: 
- [x] Deploy owner: Maria
- [x] Smoke runner: Alex
- [x] DB owner: Jenna
- [x] Netops rule: netops
- [x] Rollback plan documented in runbook (link)
If anything, call me. Thanks team :party_parrot:
Alex: I’ll keep synthetic running for 20m and will post summary when complete.
Jenna: Snapshot of primary taken pre-promote, rollback playbook tested in staging earlier today.
netops: Will monitor network metrics for 15m post-promote.
Sahil: Closing the loop — unless someone objects, I’ll mark this done in the calendar and notify account lead.
Maria: All good from my side. Mark it done.
Alex: Summary: no regressions, latency within expectations, smoke script attached to runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment marked success at 2905007029 by Maria.
Sahil: Thanks all — great job.
